## What

One or two sentences on what this pull request changes.

## Why

The reason for the change. Link the spec section, work package or ADR it comes from.

## Verification

How you proved it works. Commands run and their results, for example `pnpm lint`,
`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title, under 72 characters
- [ ] Tests sit beside the source they cover
- [ ] No em dashes in code, comments, copy or docs
- [ ] ADR added under `docs/adr/` if this deviates from the spec
